evidence.detail: R386 LoadoutsPlugin constructs rs/gui/b/h during startup, installs it as the loadout panel singleton and registers it as the navigation content titled 'Loadouts'.
Exact v308 rs/gui/b/h extends the plugin-panel base rs/ui/m and owns the complete Loadouts Swing surface, including folder selection, popup/actions and loadout-list presentation.
The panel contains exact UI tooltips 'Create a new loadout', 'Delete this loadout' and 'Rename the active loadout', plus the persistent 'Main folder' root.
Its owned graph is the already-reviewed LoadoutManager, LoadoutPersistence, DefaultLoadoutSeeder, LoadoutPreviewRenderer, LoadoutDefinition/Folder/ItemEntry/Icon and related loadout actions.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the main Loadouts plugin panel; paired directly with R386 LoadoutsPlugin.
